messages:
maya_marketing: Quick kickoff - need a concise one-pager solution brief for enterprise buyers covering security, SLAs, and deployment modes (hosted / dedicated / private). Use cases: webinar handout, inbound asset, and AE field packet. Wire draft by EOD Wed. Draft link: https://docs.google.com/draft/1aBcD (placeholder)

alex_product: Who's the primary persona? CISO/Platform lead/Infra buyer? Tone differs (exec vs technical).

maya_marketing: Primary: CISO for procurement + platform leads for technical appendix. Two micro-variants on same sheet: top exec bullets, bottom technical callouts. One CTA for demo + SLA discussion.

jordan_sales: For routing: requests mentioning SLA or private deploy -> sales-assisted (AE + solutions eng). Hosted-only/benchmarks -> self-serve nurture. Can we add a qualifying checkbox on the sheet? e.g., "I need: [ ] SOC2/PXI compliance [ ] Private VPC [ ] Dedicated capacity"

priya_solutions: Checkbox = great. Suggested hero bullets (short, measurable):
- P99 latency: <120ms for chat workloads (typical prod config)
- Throughput: 300 tokens/s per GPU pod (example)
- Unit-cost delta vs naive self-host: ~40% savings with Redwood Optimize suggestions
- Security: KMS/HSM integrations, VPC peering, audit log streaming to SIEM
- Rollout/ops: canary + A/B + automatic fallback to lighter models for capacity events

sam_engineering: Tiny benchmark snippet to paste into the brief (edit as needed):
```
Example benchmark (chat-16k seq):
- Model: open-llama-13b-quant
- Config: dedicated pool, 8x A100, batching = auto
- Median latency: 85ms
- P99 latency: 118ms
- Cost per 1M tokens: $42 (after batching/cache)
```

maya_marketing: Keep bullets punchy, avoid jargon in top half. Include a micro-infographic: three columns for Deploy Modes (Hosted / Dedicated / Private) with 2-3 checkbox items each. Who can draft column copy?

priya_solutions: Draft column copy proposals:
- Hosted: Fastest time-to-value, public model catalog, usage billing
- Dedicated: Reserved GPU pools, SLA-backed throughput, private data tenancy
- Private: VPC/on-prem, customer-managed KMS, audit & compliance exports

jordan_sales: CTA: "Schedule a 20-min SLA review + technical fit" (booking). Routing rules: if "Private" or "Dedicated" checked -> route to Solutions (priya) + AE; else -> self-serve demo funnel.

maya_marketing: Need final copy + 1-paragraph "how it works" for infra teams and a 2-line exec lead for webinar slides. Priya?

priya_solutions: On it. Will add SOC2 + ISO notes and KMS integration line.

sam_engineering: Add one-line fallback note: "Automatic fallback to compatible model variants to preserve availability under constrained capacity."

maya_marketing: Owners: priya_solutions = draft copy; sam_engineering = benchmark table + fallback; alex_product = technical check; jordan_sales = routing + CTA; maya_marketing = final copy + design handoff.

deploy-bot: Document created: https://drive.internal/redwood/marketing/enterprise-slas-onepager-draft (placeholder). Assigned: priya_solutions, sam_engineering. Due: 2024-05-01 EOD.

jordan_sales: Add small FAQ: "When to push Dedicated vs Private?" -> Dedicated = predictable throughput and isolation; Private = regulatory/air-gapped needs.

maya_marketing: Ok keeping thread focused on copy/metrics. I'll assemble the layout mock by noon tomorrow. :thumbsup:

priya_solutions: Draft uploaded tomorrow morning.

sam_engineering: All good.

maya_marketing: Thanks team!
